sources_read.section: manualOfflineSet and networkDownSet set phase directly
the phase predicate keyed on sync/phaseChanged

scope: Three fixes and their tests plus the docs. Out of scope: rung 3 (OCR), D-02's upload flow, and any change to the sync protocol or the viewport slice.

acceptance_criteria.text: The indicator raises for the leader's cursor on the current page and clears on the stroke end / idle.
manualOfflineSet(false) runs push -> pull -> resubscribe; networkDownSet(true) cancels the cycle.
A page with no annotations rasterizes once and its flattened mark becomes a candidate with text-layer text.
README, the review, the vault cache and this record carry each result and its evidence.

open_questions: Presence still takes `page` as a plain prop value, so if the viewport later gains real scroll-driven page changes the mirror must follow — it does today because the document view reports on every change.
risks: Broadening the listener predicate to any phase change could double-run the cycle if a future action sets the phase without changing it; the predicate compares current vs previous, so an unchanged phase is ignored.
Rasterizing every annotation-free page adds work; it is bounded by the page count and only runs on tap.
A colour mask is threshold-based: a pale mark is intentionally ignored (proven by the fixture's green mark).
